out.other_title: Complexity model of debate: polynomial-time judge, computationally unbounded debaters
out.rationale: Irving et al. model debate with a polynomial-time judge and computationally unbounded debaters; the authors call this assumption too strong. This is an argument about a modeling assumption with no new data on it, so CRITIQUES rather than CHALLENGES.
out.scope: proposed CRITIQUES: Whether debate guarantees should assume unbounded debaters; holds for the theoretical model of debate, not empirical LLM debate
